page.overview:
What is Wiedźmin?

Wiedźmin is a 2001 album with music of Grzegorz Ciechowski for the film The Hexer, directed by Marek Brodzki, which was an adaptation of the collection of short stories by Andrzej Sapkowski of the same title. The album contains 22 compositions.

In 2002, Ciechowski received (posthumously) the Polish Film Awards for the album in the "Best Score" category. The album has been certified "gold" by the Polish Society of the Phonographic Industry.
